exposure: Mode of delivery (vaginal delivery vs. caesarean section)
cohort: The study included 4657 women who agreed to PPIUCD insertion after being counseled among 24007 women following vaginal delivery and Lower Segment Caesarean Section.
finding: The overall acceptance rate of PPIUCD was 19.03%, with a significantly higher acceptance rate following caesarean section (34.5%) compared to vaginal delivery (6.3%).
mod_finding: The acceptance rate of PPIUCD was markedly higher after caesarean section (34.5%) compared to vaginal delivery (6.3%), and spontaneous expulsion occurred more frequently in vaginal deliveries (31.1% of expulsions) than caesarean deliveries (68.9% of expulsions) among the total 241 expulsions.
